paragraphs: From Carlow Test Centre set off along the R924 and continue for about 800 metres.
Turn left to stay on the R924.
At the roundabout take the slight left exit onto the N80.
Continue on the N80 for about 400 metres onto the dual carriageway section.
At the next roundabout keep left to stay on the N80.
At the Sleaty Road Roundabout take the exit on the left.
Follow the road for around 770 metres to the next roundabout.
At the roundabout exit left onto Cannery Road and continue for nearly 700 metres.
Continue onto Dr Cullen Road.
At the roundabout take the left exit onto Dublin Road.
At the next roundabout exit left onto O'Brien Road and continue for about 700 metres.
At the following roundabout take the slight left to remain on O'Brien Road.
Turn left onto Browneshill Road and follow it for roughly 500 metres.
Turn left into Browneshill Wood and bear right to stay on it.
Take the 1st right onto Browneshill Rise.
Practice a U-turn on Browneshill Rise and complete any reverse or turnabout the examiner requests.
Follow Browneshill Rise back out and turn left onto Browneshill Wood.
Turn right onto Browneshill Road.
At the end of Browneshill Road turn left onto O'Brien Road.
Go straight through the roundabout.
At the next roundabout take the slight left onto Carpenter Way and continue for about 400 metres.
Continue onto Paupish Bridge and go straight through the roundabout.
At the Hanover Roundabout take the slight right and turn right onto Kilkenny Road.
At the next roundabout exit left and take the slight left onto Kennedy Avenue.
Go straight through the roundabout continuing onto Kennedy Street.
Turn right onto Chapel Street.
Complete a short right and U-turn manoeuvre on the side road.
Take the slight left onto Ninety Eight Street.
Turn right onto Maryborough Street and make your way back toward Carlow Test Centre.
